svg.aria-label: A second financier’s counter. On the left an invoice, TES-INV-0007 with the buyer’s seal, slides out of an intake slot onto a tray. A board reader in the middle scans it and looks its fingerprint N up on the public board at the back, where the same N is already registered under financier A’s commitment. A round lamp marked 重 lights on financier B’s counter, a rolling shutter comes down over B’s Zcash drawer so no money leaves, and a small printer at the front prints Exhibit A: the supplier signed twice. Click it or press Enter to run it.
